biggest_catch: The headline $9,550 is paid upon completing the full study - 21 consecutive overnights at the New Haven unit plus a follow-up phone call over about 44 days - and you must pass Pfizer's screening (healthy adult 18+, and female participants must be unable to bear children).
catches: Must be a healthy adult volunteer (18+, all sexes; female participants must be unable to bear children) who can attend all visits in New Haven, CT - must pass screening and comply with all study procedures
Study involves an investigational oral drug; risks, monitoring, and procedures are disclosed in the informed consent form during screening
Time commitment is 21 consecutive overnights at the facility, 1 follow-up phone call, about 44 days total; 'up to $9,550' paid upon completion of the study
Location-specific: Pfizer Clinical Research Unit, 1 Howe St, New Haven, CT 06511 (phone 800-254-6398)
Must remain at the PCRU for the entire duration of each inpatient stay unless you choose to withdraw

c1.evidence: pfizerclinicaltrials.com is the official provider-owned domain of the Pfizer Clinical Research Unit; page title 'Healthy Volunteer Breast Cancer Clinical Trial | Pfizer Clinical Research Unit'.

c2.evidence: Official listing page marks study C4551008 'Oral Study Drug for Breast Cancer with Food' as 'Recruiting' (checked live 2026-09-23); study page states 'Compensation: Up to $9,550 upon completion of the study'.

c3.evidence: Healthy-volunteer research study; no participation fee stated; study drug, monitoring, and informed consent described.

c4.evidence: Compensation (up to $9,550 upon completion), eligibility (healthy adults 18+, all sexes, females unable to bear children), study (C4551008 oral study drug with/without high-fat meal), and location (New Haven, CT facility) all stated on official pages.

eligibility: Healthy adult volunteers 18+, all sexes; female participants must be unable to bear children; willing and able to come to the New Haven, CT facility and comply with all study procedures.
notes: One provider = one route. The official listing shows other PCRU studies under this same route (e.g., C6611001B up to $8,200, C6611001C up to $3,250) - not separate routes.
numeric_basis: payout from official study page (up to $9,550 upon completion); time: 21 consecutive overnights; active awake on-site time estimated ~10,000-14,000 min (excludes sleep).
payout_quote: Up to $9,550 upon completion of the study
payout_value_note: Up to $9,550 upon completion of the study (variable per participant completion).

steps: Open https://www.pfizerclinicaltrials.com/c4551008 and review the study requirements
Call 1-800-254-6398 to pre-screen and confirm enrollment details
Attend a screening visit at the Pfizer Clinical Research Unit, 1 Howe St, New Haven, CT
If qualified, complete the 21-overnight stay and 1 follow-up phone call over about 44 days
timing: 21 consecutive overnights at the New Haven facility, 1 follow-up phone call, about 44 days total. Active on-site time estimated 10,000-14,000 minutes (excludes sleep).
